doctrine.objective: Consolidate a strong economic base first. Growth through income and reserves, never through risky conquest.
doctrine.economy: Keep a large gold reserve and recruit only when it is affordable. Solvency outranks soldiers in every budget decision.
doctrine.risk: Avoid losses. Fight only with overwhelming strength, and retreat from any engagement that could cost a character.
doctrine.diplomacy: Seek allies and keep relations open. Gifts, loans and neutrality protect the treasury better than any army.
